snip.t: Urinary calcium excretion (24‑h): Distinguish familial hypocalciuric hypercalcaemia — Low urinary calcium despite hypercalcaemia suggests familial form
Special tests (PTHrP, urinary calcium) for malignancy or familial hypocalciuric hypercalcaemia.
Familial hypocalciuric hypercalcaemia (FHH): benign, due to inactivating CaSR mutations; mild hypercalcaemia with low urine calcium (calcium/creatinine clearance ratio under 1%); do not need surgery.
